why: RJ-P02, pending #5951 (items 2 and 3): the command line's Photo draws text through a fake that paints nothing and knows only the System family, so the words never reach the export and no bundled family can be picked, and platforms is [] until it draws through live text. Opens beach.png (64 x 48 sRGB), adds "SUMMER SALE" at the centre, sets a weight-900 family, size 120 and centre alignment, saves, and exports a PNG. The trap: text rasterised on save, or the font silently swapped on reopen. The turn-on names the bundled family in text.set-font, adds the reopen after file.save, checks text.read still says that family at weight 900, size 120 and centre, puts the reference export under expected/, and sets platforms to linux and macos.
